taxonomy.note: Accepted by current Kew POWO and ITIS; native to Texas.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: County-level USDA-derived native listings currently lock Comal and Kerr inside the project target zone. Broader USDA/Kew sources confirm Texas nativity but do not supply a third exact target-zone county in this review.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need one more exact target-zone native county.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not convert broad Central Texas/Southern Great Plains distribution into an exact county.

morphology.look_here_first: Leadplant is the low gray one: a short prairie subshrub with densely silky-gray compound leaves and narrow upright spikes of violet-purple flowers.
diagnostic_traits: dense gray-white hairs on leaves and young stems
much shorter and grayer than A. fruticosa
